subject: projects.records

entries.definition: A bounded body of work that groups outcomes, milestones, embedded work items, decisions, questions, and status independently from CRM and provider layout.
A Project objective or outcome composed of exact work items whose progress and health remain separate from Task state.
An exact unit of Project-local work that remains embedded and coordination-scoped until an operator explicitly promotes it into tracked Task execution.
A dated, categorized, visibility-scoped Project fact covering an update, status, Decision, Question, or milestone without rewriting the whole Project.
A Project feed fact recording exactly what was decided, by whom, and why or that the why was not supplied.
An unresolved Project feed fact that may be processed only by an exact governed resolution tied to its Decision and work item.

limitations: This vocabulary defines portable Project meaning only; it grants no provider, approval, execution, or health authority.
Task, CRM, Meeting, document, and channel relationships remain typed external resource identities.
